topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Walking down memory lane, the old school stands much as it did, a sentinel of yesterday's whispers. I glance up, the sign barely changed, and step inside, a ripple of deja vu sweeping through me. There she is, the same gentle smile, the same warm eyes, her presence a soft echo of times past. My child, so full of life and curiosity, unknowingly steps into a chapter I've already read. As I watch them, the small hand reaching up, the big hand reaching down, a convergence of paths, I can't help but see the threads of my own youth, woven now into this new tapestry. The classroom, a capsule of shared beginnings, hums with a familiar energy, a bridge between then and now.
